CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_esim_operation_timeline(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.assert_admin();
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('order_id',o.id,'kind',o.operation_kind,'status',o.status,'delivery_state',o.delivery_state,
 'finance_kind',r.finance_kind,'settlement_state',r.settlement_state,'submitted_at',r.submitted_at,'receipt_at',r.receipt_at,
 'error_code',r.error_code,'attempts',r.attempts,'next_check_at',r.next_check_at,'has_hold',r.hold_id IS NOT NULL,
 'has_original_debit',r.debit_tx_id IS NOT NULL,'has_settlement',r.settlement_tx_id IS NOT NULL,'receipt_hash',r.receipt_hash,
 'events',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('received_at',received_at,'status',status,'kind',kind)),'[]') FROM esim_private.events
  WHERE account_id=r.account_id AND (submission_ref=r.submission_ref OR order_ref=r.provider_order_ref))) INTO result
 FROM public.esim_orders o JOIN esim_private.order_runs r ON r.order_id=o.id WHERE o.id=p_order_id;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_esim_support(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.assert_admin();
 IF length(coalesce(p_query,''))>100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid search'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO result FROM (
 SELECT e.id,e.user_id AS owner_id,right(e.iccid,4) AS iccid_suffix,e.profile_state,e.installation_state,e.bundle_state,e.last_observation_at,e.usage_observed_at,e.usage_error_code,
 (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'action',c.action,'state',c.state,'submitted_at',c.submitted_at,'error_code',c.error_code)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM esim_private.controls c WHERE c.profile_id=e.id) AS controls,
 (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('order_id',o.id,'kind',o.operation_kind,'status',o.status,'state',r.state,'error_code',r.error_code)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.esim_orders o LEFT JOIN esim_private.order_runs r ON r.order_id=o.id WHERE o.id=e.order_id OR o.recharge_profile_id=e.id) AS operations
 FROM public.user_esims e WHERE e.provider='esimaccess' AND (e.id::text=p_query OR e.user_id::text=p_query OR
 (p_query~'^[0-9]{4}$' AND right(e.iccid,4)=p_query) OR (coalesce(p_query,'')='' AND (esim_private.control_pending(e.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM esim_private.order_runs r JOIN public.esim_orders o ON o.id=r.order_id WHERE (o.id=e.order_id OR o.recharge_profile_id=e.id) AND r.state IN('reconciling','support_required')))))
 ORDER BY e.last_observation_at NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50) x;
 PERFORM public.admin_log('esim.support.search','esim',NULL,NULL,jsonb_build_object('returned',jsonb_array_length(result)),'Redacted support search');
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('profiles',result,'runtime',public.admin_esim_runtime_status(),
 'switches',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('cancellation_enabled',cancellation_enabled,'service_controls_enabled',service_controls_enabled,'automation_enabled',automation_enabled) FROM esim_private.accounts WHERE account_key='primary'),
 'funding_health','UNKNOWN','credential_health','UNKNOWN',
 'catalogue_last_sync',(SELECT max(updated_at) FROM public.esim_offers_cache WHERE provider='esimaccess'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gate_esim_order_submission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$DECLARE a esim_private.accounts; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT a FROM esim_private.accounts WHERE account_key='primary';
 IF NEW.provider<>'esimaccess' OR (NEW.operation_kind='purchase' AND (NOT a.new_sales_enabled OR NOT a.wallet_boundary_verified))
  OR (NEW.operation_kind IN('fixed_recharge','daily_extension') AND NOT esim_private.recharge_can_accept()) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'eSIM purchases are temporarily unavailable while delivery safeguards are verified'; END IF;
 NEW.delivery_state:='queued';RETURN NEW; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_esim_operation_history(p_profile_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE u uuid:=auth.uid(); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 PERFORM esim_private.require_live_owner(u);
 IF p_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_esims WHERE id=p_profile_id AND user_id=u) THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]') INTO result FROM(
  SELECT o.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',o.id,'profile_id',o.recharge_profile_id,'kind',o.operation_kind,'package_id',o.bundle_name,
   'retail_total',o.total_amount_usd,'currency','USD','status',o.status,'delivery_state',o.delivery_state,'created_at',o.created_at,
   'financial_state',coalesce(r.settlement_state,'support_required'),'funds_reserved',r.finance_kind='reserved' AND r.settlement_state='pending',
   'confirmed_expiry',CASE WHEN e.expiry_confirmed THEN e.provider_expires_at END,'duration_value',coalesce(e.duration_value,(o.catalogue_snapshot->>'period_count')::integer),'duration_unit',coalesce(e.duration_unit,CASE WHEN o.catalogue_snapshot->>'period_count' IS NOT NULL THEN 'DAY' END),
   'support_required',o.delivery_state='support_required') value
  FROM public.esim_orders o LEFT JOIN esim_private.order_runs r ON r.order_id=o.id
  LEFT JOIN esim_private.entitlements e ON e.order_id=o.id WHERE o.user_id=u
   AND (p_profile_id IS NULL OR o.recharge_profile_id=p_profile_id OR o.id=(SELECT order_id FROM public.user_esims WHERE id=p_profile_id AND user_id=u))
  ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 50) rows;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.queue_esim_order_delivery()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO esim_private.order_runs(order_id,account_id,submission_ref,state)
 SELECT NEW.id,a.id,'esim_'||NEW.id::text,'prepared' FROM esim_private.accounts a WHERE a.account_key='primary';
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
